answer: An farming party running 174 aliases therefore needs 113 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in orchard, expire in vault, and zenith lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3211 identities would post 1207 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
